description: This bar chart illustrates the branching ratio γ_B for different numbers of shots, ranging from 0 to 4, with each shot count represented by a pair of grouped bars: a blue bar with a dotted pattern labeled “Incorrect” and a magenta bar with diagonal stripes labeled “Correct,” as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis is labeled “Number of Shots” and displays integer values from 0 to 4 in ascending order. The vertical axis is labeled “γ_B” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 0.2. For each shot count, the “Incorrect” bar (blue, dotted) is consistently shorter than the “Correct” bar (magenta, diagonal stripes). Specifically, the values are approximately: at 0 shots, the “Incorrect” bar is at 0.40 and the “Correct” bar is at 0.70; at 1 shot, the “Incorrect” bar is at 0.40 and the “Correct” bar is at 0.68; at 2 shots, the “Incorrect” bar is at 0.36 and the “Correct” bar is at 0.66; at 3 shots, the “Incorrect” bar is at 0.32 and the “Correct” bar is at 0.64; and at 4 shots, the “Incorrect” bar is at 0.30 and the “Correct” bar is at 0.45. The bars are not sorted and are presented in ascending order of the number of shots along the x-axis. There are no visual emphasis features such as shading, bolding, or annotations on any of the bars.
